embed_text:
What proprietary DSP features do you have that can help us optimize for the most cost-efficient bids against HCPs?

PulsePoint offers multiple bid optimization tools directly in the platform. By nature, the DSP is programmed to be as cost efficient and opportunistic as possible. The aim of the campaign is both to achieve brand KPIs as a top priority, but also to avoid costs where they are unnecessary against competition. A few ways that the platform does this is through media optimization settings, which include the ability to program tactics to achieve the most cost efficient CPM, and custom bidding settings against various filters that may be appended to the tactics through bid multipliers. A difference about the LIFE platform in comparison to other platforms is that LIFE uses the base bid as essentially the “max” bid, and where possible, uses a range of $0 to base bid in order to inform just how much we can lower the bid while still winning against priority HCPs in the platform. It is of utmost importance to balance low media costs with the data costs that are often associated with doctor targeting, and the platform is wired to achieve the strongest cost per NPI reach in the market.

Can your DSP optimize towards Audience Quality, Scripts, claims data?

PulsePoint has integrated technology in order to optimize towards Audience Quality, Scripts, claims data, and all clinical and digital health signals in various ways directly into the platform. PulsePoint's real-time bidding engine includes proprietary, health-specific optimization strategies that address all three of these inputs. PulsePoint’s Adaptive Optimization™ capabilities actively suggest and apply predictive optimizations at the tactic level. These optimizations are surfaced through the Optimization Strategy setting during tactic setup, where users can select factors related to audience quality, scripts, and claims data that orient around their brand goals and KPIs. These factors include but are not limited to Diagnosis claims data (Dx), Prescription data (Rx), procedure data (Px), and many more. Adaptive Optimization™ does not change your audience targeting. Instead, it applies PulsePoint’s high-value clinical and digital data to optimize bids in real time. By scoring and prioritizing audience cohorts based on clinical relevance and health behaviors, without altering your target audience, it focuses your budget on the people most relevant to the factors selected. What AI-powered and agentic capabilities are currently available within your DSP, and what is your roadmap over the next 12–24 months? Please distinguish between generally available features, beta products, and future concepts.

PulsePoint combines real-time data, privacy-by-design infrastructure, and AI optimization in a platform purpose-built for healthcare marketing. Unlike generalist DSPs, we're rooted in proprietary, clinically relevant data, which lets campaigns stay privacy-compliant while still supporting precise HCP and DTC targeting across the health journey. AI isn't a layer added on top, it's built into how campaigns are planned, executed, and measured, and it's paired with curated data partnerships (Medscape, WebMD) that go beyond what traditional platforms offer.
Available Today
Adaptive Optimization: our proprietary AI bidding engine, which goes beyond standard media optimization by incorporating real-time clinical signals and exclusive Medscape/WebMD behavioral data
LIFE Media Planner: uses AI to predict impression volume, spend, and opportunity windows through Forecasting Ranges, enabling audience sizing and scenario modeling before a campaign launches
STUDIO / HCP Explorer: includes an AI agent that turns open-ended research questions into tangible HCP audiences, which can then be explored further or activated directly within LIFE
Pilot Stage (Beyond Beta): Hatch
Hatch, unveiled at HealthNEXT in August 2026, is a step change beyond feature-level AI: a conversational, agentic platform where users describe what they need in plain language and Hatch interprets intent, configures itself, and acts, all in one continuous workflow. It unifies research and planning, audience intelligence, and measurement with programmatic activation, connected to the same proprietary data foundation behind Adaptive Optimization and HCP Explorer, with full transparency and source links for every answer. Current pilot capabilities (internal product and account teams only):
Open-ended research answered directly from live data (e.g., which specialties are shifting fastest toward a new treatment class)
Natural-language querying of delivery, pacing, budget, and performance
NPI-level visibility into which providers a campaign reached, by specialty, list membership, and channel engagement
Monitoring of bid funnel, win rates, creative performance, and flight schedules
Adaptive personalization to individual user preferences and working style over time
Roadmap (Next 12–24 Months)
Hatch: expansion from internal pilot to a select group of alpha clients, followed by broader GA rollout, with the agentic feature set extending further into a complete "act on campaign data" workflow across the full research-to-activation-to-measurement lifecycle

HCP: Unmatched Precision + Endemic Scale PulsePoint delivers a uniquely powerful combination of deterministic HCP identity, clinical intelligence, and premium endemic scale. As the only fully consented, deterministic activation platform capable of identifying and activating authenticated first-party NPIs using NPI-level and clinical behavioral signals, PulsePoint enables brands to reach the right HCPs with greater precision and relevance. Our exclusive DSP relationship with Medscape further differentiates PulsePoint, providing unparalleled access to Medscape data and inventory and delivering the largest endemic programmatic scale and reach in the industry. DTC: Smarter Targeting Across the Patient Journey PulsePoint brings the same level of healthcare intelligence to consumer activation. As the only first-party validated platform offering a journey-based suite of targeting and attribution solutions, PulsePoint combines deterministic and contextual capabilities to identify and engage relevant consumers throughout their healthcare journey. With access to WebMD-powered inventory and audiences—including patients actively engaging with WebMD health content—brands can connect with highly relevant consumers in meaningful healthcare moments. HCP + DTC: One Connected Healthcare Ecosystem Where PulsePoint truly stands apart is our ability to connect HCP and DTC strategy rather than activate them in silos. By leveraging signals from Medscape, WebMD, and other clinically and digitally relevant sources, PulsePoint helps brands capitalize on the natural relationship between HCPs and the patients they treat. Our technology enables agencies to use HCP behaviors and insights to inform DTC activation—and consumer signals to inform HCP strategy—creating a more intelligent, coordinated approach across the healthcare journey. Customized solutions can reach both priority HCPs and their relevant patient populations at the moments that matter most: at the point of care, between appointments, and even in markets where HCPs are seeing increased volumes of patients with specific symptoms or conditions. The result is a more connected activation strategy designed to surround the healthcare journey with relevant messaging, drive greater engagement, and ultimately support better health outcomes.

Does your ID Graph have an integration with any SSPs, and if so, which?

PulsePoint uses encrypted ID synchronization with identity providers such as LiveRamp, ID5, and Unified ID 2.0. This ensures that any identity information shared between PulsePoint and external partners is securely encrypted and cannot be spoofed or tampered with. By using encrypted first-party data, PulsePoint ensures that only validated and authorized users are targeted. This helps detect when a fraudulent user attempts to impersonate a legitimate one.

Please explain how you maintain Audience Quality across various destination points for media activation.

PulsePoint has integrated technology in order to optimize towards Audience Quality, Scripts, claims data, and all clinical and digital health signals in various ways directly into the platform. PulsePoint's real-time bidding engine includes proprietary, health-specific optimization strategies that address all three of these inputs. PulsePoint’s Adaptive Optimization™ capabilities actively suggest and apply predictive optimizations at the tactic level. These optimizations are surfaced through the Optimization Strategy setting during tactic setup, where users can select factors related to audience quality, scripts, and claims data that orient around their brand goals and KPIs. These factors include but are not limited to Diagnosis claims data (Dx), Prescription data (Rx), procedure data (Px), and many more. Adaptive Optimization™ does not change your audience targeting. Instead, it applies PulsePoint’s high-value clinical and digital data to optimize bids in real time. By scoring and prioritizing audience cohorts based on clinical relevance and health behaviors, without altering your target audience, it focuses your budget on the people most relevant to the factors selected. This reduces wasted spend, improves campaign efficiency, and respects privacy. PulsePoint also has integrations with Crossix and IQVIA in order to properly optimize campaigns based on Crossix and IQVIA measurement - whichever the brand has a contract with. This allows campaigns to be automatically optimizing towards 3rd party Audience Quality values, so that PulsePoint remains agnostic to the way that clients measure campaigns. On top of that, PulsePoint has a series of dashboards and insights tools that allow clients to see near real-time reporting of Audience Quality, scripts, and claims analytics, so that users are both automatically and manually able to make optimizations within the platform.
